description.value:
Furrykin. Normalized Bad Eden ancestry root.

Select one heritage separately when building the character: Felid, Leporid, Mustelid, Ursid, Vulpin.

This root grants the shared Furrykin core trait package and preserves live UUID compatibility for existing feature items.

“You are not an animal that learned to talk. You are a person the world made with fur because it needed you to survive.”

Wildframe. Your body is built for a world that bites back. You have advantage on saving throws against disease and environmental poison.

Keen Sense. Choose one: Keen Smell, Keen Hearing, or Keen Sight. You have advantage on Perception checks relying on that sense.

Clade Instinct. Choose a Furrykin clade (Vulpin, Mustelid, Leporid, Ursid, Felid). Your clade grants Tier powers as you level.

Pack/Trouble Magnet. When you first meet an NPC group, the GM may decide you are treated as: harmless, useful, or suspicious. You look like folklore with a knife. People react.

advancement.title: Wildframe & Instinct
advancement.hint: Gain the core Furrykin ancestry traits.

senses.special: Keen Sense (choose smell, hearing, or sight).
